name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
description: Soft curds of egg cooked gently in butter, served on crisp toasted bread. A comforting breakfast with creamy texture and mild savoury flavour.
ingredients: Eggs whole 2|Bread whole wheat 2 slices|Butter 10g|Milk whole 30ml|Salt to taste|Black pepper powder 1g
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper in a bowl|Heat butter in a non-stick pan over low heat|Pour in egg mixture; let sit 10 sec without stirring|Gently fold eggs with a spatula every 15 sec until softly set|Toast bread slices until golden|Serve scrambled eggs over toast immediately
